name: Table 1, IC 1 — small waves
setup: Table 1, IC 1 from the paper (Figs. 2–3, top left). Small height waves (Ah = 0.2, three wavelengths) riding on a uniform flow V = 1. Inside the training range.
expect: Plain coarse LLF smears the waves away almost completely by t = 200. Both NN models should follow the black DNS line. Look closely at q: the network alone was never told to stay smooth, so small wiggles are possible.
observed: The NN without the limiter does develop visible small-scale wiggles in q. MCL-NN removes them and is the more accurate of the two (q error 0.47% vs 0.66%). This is the paper's point about MCL cleaning up an imperfect network.
